description.value: A family-run bed and breakfast on a one-acre property just 2 km from Clearwater, gateway to Wells Gray Provincial Park. Two accommodation options: a spacious suite sleeping four and a rustic forest cabin sleeping two, both with their own patio, gazebo, and BBQ. The owners partner with Wells Gray Outfitters to offer bike rental packages for exploring the area.

address.value: 217 Sunshine Valley Road, Clearwater, BC V0E 1N2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active B&B in Clearwater with two accommodation options, continental breakfast, laundry in both units, and nearby restaurants (Gateway Grill, 52 Ridge). They offer summer bike rental packages through Wells Gray Outfitters, showing cycling awareness, but no mention of secure bike storage, bike tools, or cycling-specific amenities on the property itself. Contact details on the website match the OSM address; OSM had no phone but the website lists 1-250-674-3051.
concerns: OSM name is 'Woodcrest' but business brands as 'Woodcrest BnB'
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, licensed B&B in Clearwater near Wells Gray Park with bike rental partnerships, laundry, and nearby dining — a solid touring cyclist overnight option pending confirmation of bike storage arrangements.
enrichment_extras.notes: Breakfast is included (continental with homemade baking) but no evidence it can be served early or packed. The bike rental packages suggest cycling awareness but no on-site bike storage is described.

Laundry.detail: Both the Woodcrest Suite and Owl's Wing Guesthouse include a washer and dryer

Nearby evening food.detail: Gateway Grill Restaurant and 52 Ridge pub mentioned as nearby dining options
